asset.description: Closed PET water bottle with the original ForgeCAD ALPINE SPRING label and selected pet_water / clear_blue_tint materials; one rigid body. EP2 identity retained.
asset.mass_source: Retain the prior EP2 full-bottle mass of 0.54 kg; affine-scale and combine ForgeCAD component inertia tensors, then normalize to that mass. The nonuniformly scaled visible liquid is not mass-calibrated to 500 mL (review estimates approximately 604 mL); this is a fixed task-object mass, not a measured fill-density model.

licensing.creator: ForgeCAD
licensing.basis: CC-BY-4.0 in the pinned repository README and asset SimReady_Metadata; author ForgeCAD in the pinned main USD.
licensing.scope: ForgeCAD source geometry, collision geometry, water-label.png artwork and forgecad_glass.mdl, modified by RLWRLD. Original source label is retained byte-for-byte.
licensing.attribution: ForgeCAD, CC BY 4.0; modified by RLWRLD. Source, changes and license link: ../LICENSE.md.

modifications: Bake closed transforms and scale to the EP2 envelope
Restore four original label meshes, face-varying UVs and byte-exact water-label.png
Keep the 30722-triangle simplified body/liquid/cap and restore 1456 source label triangles (32178 total)
Merge cap, liner, tamper band and contents into one 0.54 kg body with no joints
Retain 71 source convex colliders unchanged from the intermediate candidate; no superseded bottle geometry reused
Keep EP2 registration and recorded body/visual prim paths
Preserve original selected Preview/MDL material graphs and author grasp line / disabled-by-default Newton payload
Simplify in millimeter coordinates to preserve the thin PET shell; restore meter coordinates
Transfer source smooth normals; preserve original PET/water/Closure/Seal shader parameters
Approximate the helical neck thread under the fixed cap with annular source-profile geometry; preserve source smooth normals

supersedes.history: Earlier versions and their license exclusions remain in Git history and CHANGELOG.md; those declarations do not describe this replacement.

provenance.material_appearance: Restore the original pet_water / clear_blue_tint Preview and MDL graphs, including PET roughness 0.04, original cap and Seal colors, and front/back label UV transforms; no current scene-render equivalence claim.

grasp_lines.evidence: Exercised on the replacement geometry with scripts/tools/newton15_cert.py; this is a standalone Newton test, not the NVIDIA Isaac Sim benchmark.

benchmark_newton15.engine: Newton 1.5.2 standalone (MuJoCo-Warp), not the Arena image
benchmark_newton15.message: authored line held through lift, hold and shake

benchmark.reason: Replacement does not inherit the superseded bottle's PhysX benchmark. Standalone Newton drop/slope/grasp results are recorded separately.

eval_compatibility.note: The old epoch cannot be scored as this physical epoch. Headline recording/filter/freeze is complete; sensitivity is not newly validated. This metadata correction does not change geometry, mass, friction or prior certificate results.

newton15.engine: Newton 1.5.2 standalone (MuJoCo-Warp), not the Arena image

ground_drop.engine: Newton 1.5.2 standalone (MuJoCo-Warp), not the Arena image

slope_drop.engine: Newton 1.5.2 standalone (MuJoCo-Warp), not the Arena image
slope_drop.message: creep 10.0 mm/s while 'at rest' (MuJoCo soft contact); tipped over (106 deg from the authored pose)

friction.reason: Retain the replacement candidate parameters actually qualified by standalone checks and the fresh headline settle recordings. They differ from the superseded contour bottle and are not claimed equivalent.

colliders.shape: Convex pieces of a hollow shell, including 13 body wall staves, base and cap pieces; not a solid cylinder. Thin walls and polygonal rolling support change contacts.

physical_change_from_previous_ep2.physx: The prior physx.usd runnable and PhysX variant are removed; this package exposes only Newton. Previous PhysX certificates do not transfer.
